entities.summary: Marek Mazanec is a Czech professional ice hockey goaltender currently playing for HC Oceláři Třinec of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). Mazanec has previously played for the Nashville Predators, who selected him in the sixth round, 179th overall, of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft.
